description: This Lua script defines functions for pattern matching and rendering data structures as JSON-like strings. It includes functions to identify array-like tables, perform deep rendering, and match patterns with bindings, including array concatenation and mapping.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Determines if a table is array-like with consecutive integer keys starting at 1.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Converts Lua data structures into JSON-like string representations.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Performs pattern matching with support for variables, arrays, and nested tables.
